promotion.reason: Committed dzn full-tier parity rows pass, but every measured CWBVH same-scene timing ratio is slower than binary traversal.
promotion.requiredEvidence: browser/real-adapter throughput A/B over broader workloads before making CWBVH the default traversal; capture with npm run cwbvh-default-promotion-repeats -- --repeats=5 --warmup=1

measurementSufficiency.requiredEvidence: multiple repeats per workload on browser/real-adapter hosts with warmup-discarded timing before making CWBVH the default traversal; capture with npm run cwbvh-default-promotion-repeats -- --repeats=5 --warmup=1

repeatEvidence.requiredEvidence: browser/real-adapter throughput A/B beyond the committed WSL dzn repeat campaign before making CWBVH the default traversal
repeatEvidence.residual: The committed WSL dzn campaign completed five warmup-discarded samples per workload and still found slower median CWBVH timing, with one material-lobe-map fast outlier that is not enough for default promotion.
